sources.enterprise_floor: synthflow.ai/pricing read 2026-10-20: 'Enterprise contracts start at $30,000 annually' (data/teardown/synthflow/site/pricing.html)
sources.last_public_paygo: research/2026-10-17/lanes/l4a-competitors/pricing-history.json obs 2026-03-14 and 2026-06-16 (Common Crawl): voice engine $0.09/min + LLM $0.02 (GPT-4.1 mini) .. $0.05 (GPT-4.1) + managed Twilio $0.02 (US)
sources.twilio_india_mobile: research/2026-10-20/teardown/vapi/pricing.json: twilio.com/en-us/voice/pricing/in India-Mobile $0.0496/min; outbound to India only from non-Indian numbers
sources.vapi_calculator_components: research/2026-10-20/teardown/vapi/pricing.json: Deepgram $0.0095-0.0099, OpenAI $0.0077-0.0452, ElevenLabs $0.0146-0.0238 per min (pass-through list prices)
sources.plivo_india: research/2026-10-17/lanes/l2-economics (vendor-and-telephony-prices.csv): Plivo India INR 0.38/min, 30 s pulse; media anchoring in India required

current_public_price.model: sales-led enterprise only; no per-minute list price published

india_outbound_allin_estimate.path: last public platform rate + BYO Twilio to an Indian mobile from a non-Indian caller ID (Synthflow sells US/CA/AU numbers only; SIP trunk is Enterprise-only and Synthflow has no India PoP)
india_outbound_allin_estimate.caveat: the 2026 enterprise per-minute rate is unpublished; the H1 2026 PAYG rate is used as the best public anchor

cogs_reconstruction_usd_per_min.grade: inferred (stack from docs/bundle/job posts; component prices are other vendors' list prices, Synthflow's negotiated rates unknown)
cogs_reconstruction_usd_per_min.note: Since 2026-08-25 non-enterprise agents run on Synthflow LLM, and Synthflow STT/TTS exist; moving the three AI lines in-house is consistent with pushing COGS below the third-party floor (inferred; in-house cost unknown).

vs_2026_10_17.change: no new public per-minute price since 2026-06; enterprise-only floor $30k/yr confirmed unchanged since 2026-09-10

verifier_2026_10_20.note: Lane figures above are kept as computed. Corrections (see verify.md, SYN-41/42).
verifier_2026_10_20.upper_bound_basis: Synthflow's own H1-2026 'PAYG typically $0.15-0.24/min' (pricing-history.json, CC 2026-03-14 and 2026-06-16) minus its $0.02 managed US Twilio leg plus Twilio India mobile $0.0496 = $0.1796-0.2696 = INR 17.06-25.61
verifier_2026_10_20.floor_treatment: pricing.py treats the $30k/yr floor as a usage commitment (max of floor/min and usage rate); Synthflow does not say whether it is a commitment or a fee on top. As a fee on top, add INR 47.5 / 23.75 / 9.5 per minute at 5k / 10k / 25k min per month.
verifier_2026_10_20.cogs_caveats: own_infra_sbc_freeswitch_janus_gcp ($0.002-0.006) has no source and is a placeholder; component prices are Vapi's pass-through rates, not Synthflow's costs; non-enterprise agents run on Synthflow LLM since 2026-08-25
